look_here_first: Ignore the yellow flowers at first and count leaflets. Twoleaf senna has exactly one pair of leaflets per leaf. Then check the small gland between that pair, the low perennial habit, and the flattened legume pods.

project_inclusion.range_basis: B123: Hays — UT Plant Resources Center Purola natural flora; Williamson — UT PRC county flora; Kerr — NYBG Heller voucher from Kerrville.

best_field_traits: herbaceous perennial from a thick root, usually low-growing
alternate leaves consistently even-2-foliolate: exactly two leaflets
narrowly lanceolate to slightly falcate leaflets
small stalked gland on the leaf axis between the leaflet pair
axillary racemes with a few yellow five-petaled flowers
morphology_keys.comparison_training: S. lindheimeriana is taller and velvety with 4–8 pairs of leaflets. S. pilosior is an annual western/desert comparison. The exactly-two-leaflet leaf is the fastest field character.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Exactly one leaflet pair per leaf separates S. roemeriana quickly from the many-paired S. lindheimeriana; confirm the interfoliolar gland and pod.
